narrative.northStar: A place for ideas to take shape
narrative.overview: A light, operational Mac workspace with a PiDesk-family identity. The shell uses lavender-gray tonal separation; the artifact sits on a clean canvas.

rules.name: The Artifact Boundary Rule
rules.body: Workspace colors stop at the prototype iframe. A selected design system controls the artifact’s colors; it never recolors the app shell.

dos: Preserve the separation between the workspace and the generated artifact.
Use the real catalog and local run state, including empty and failure cases.
Keep native keyboard conventions and visible focus.
donts: Add account, billing, publishing, or collaboration controls without working capabilities.
Describe prototype frames as separate πDesigner clients.
Imply the light theme has a complete dark-mode counterpart.
